top_signals.title: Bessent and the Fed Help Japan Reverse Months of Yen Losses
top_signals.summary: The US joined Japan in engineering one of the most notable rebounds in the yen since the currency began its years-long slide, a decline that’s stoked inflation in the Asian nation and rippled through global markets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
